summary_en: 6,000,000 shares (2.08% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) up to ¥15.0 billion aggregate. Open-market purchase via Tokyo Stock Exchange. Execution window 10 Aug 2026 – 16 Oct 2026. Rationale: enhance capital efficiency and corporate value.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: Iyogin Holdings' board of directors has authorized the acquisition of up to 6,000,000 treasury shares (2.08% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) at an aggregate cost not to exceed ¥15.0 billion. The shares will be purchased via open-market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 10 August 2026 and 16 October 2026. The stated purpose is to enhance capital efficiency and corporate value. As of 30 June 2026, the company held 26,310,203 treasury shares (including 1,530,600 shares held by a trust associated with the company's equity compensation plan) against 313,408,831 shares outstanding.
